caseNameFull: Ex parte The Public National Bank of New York
attorneys: Messrs. Henry L. Moses,. Martin Saxe, Robert C.'Begtty, Herman G. Kopald, Edward F., Colladay, Albert Óttinger, and Henry S'. Manley for petitioner.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

■The motion for leave to file petition for a writ of mandamus is granted and a rule to show cause is ordered to issue returnable on Monday, October 29, next.
